name: ERP Push Agent
description: Pushes a stored invoice to whichever live ERP this run targets: JDE (CheckPO -> AddSupplierInvoice -> approval-hold-and-email if required -> RunVMADriverUBE) or EBS (create_invoices REST call). Reads the invoice back from the ennvault database by src_id.

skills.name: Push Invoice To ERP
skills.description: Pushes a stored invoice (read back by src_id) to the live ERP for this run's target_erp -- JDE's multi-step orchestrator flow (with voucher-approval email/hold) or EBS's create_invoices REST call.
examples: Push this extracted invoice to the ERP

metadata.boundary: Final-stage live ERP submission, for whichever ERP this run targets
metadata.autoSubmit: Unlike this codebase's prior EBS-only document agent, this agent has no its-own auto-submit opt-in flag -- matching ennVault_org_backend's push_to_jde/push_to_ebs_inv, it always attempts the live push for whichever ERP it's asked to push to, whenever the orchestrator calls it
metadata.recreatedFrom: ennVault_org_backend/ERP/JDE/inv_payload.py::push_to_jde and ERP/EBS/inv_payload.py::push_to_ebs_inv (exact multi-step flow and REST payload shapes) and ERP/db.py + modules/email_module/service.py (DB read-back/update and voucher-approval email)
